source.document: AISC, Companion to the AISC Steel Construction Manual, Volume 1: Design Examples, Version 16.0 (2023), accompanying ANSI/AISC 360-22
source.pages: printed page F-n = PDF page 162+n; H-n = PDF page 262+n
source.content: Only numbers are recorded here: the inputs each example lists and the values it prints (3 significant figures). No text, table or figure of the document is reproduced.
source.units: kip, in. (ksi); moments in kip-ft and lengths in ft where the key says so (as printed); converted in the tests
source.tolerancePolicy: the single policy of aisc_design_examples_v16.json (tests/design_examples/__init__.py: assert_printed) applies unchanged

F.1-1B.title: W18x50, major axis, continuously braced: yielding
notes: Compactness is asserted by the example (User Note of Spec. F2); bf/2tf and h/tw are not listed.

F.1-2B.title: W18x50, major axis, braced at the ends and third points: inelastic LTB with Cb
notes: Zx = 101 in.^3 and the loads (wu = 1.74, wa = 1.20 kip/ft on 35 ft) are those of Examples F.1-1A/B, to which this example refers (Mp = 5,050 kip-in.).

Rounded chain: the example evaluates Eq. F2-2 with Lb = 11.7 ft, Lp = 5.83 ft, Lr = 16.9 ft, Cb = 1.01 (4,060 kip-in.); full precision from the listed properties with Lb = 35/3 ft and Cb = 1.0135 gives 4,086 kip-in. (+0.65 %), inside the policy.
Compactness asserted by the example; ratios not listed.

F.1-3B.title: W18x50, major axis, braced at the ends and midspan: elastic LTB with Cb
notes: ry = 1.65 in. is listed for the same shape in Example F.1-2B (this example takes Lp and Lr from Manual Table 3-2).

F.3B.title: W21x48, major axis, continuously braced: noncompact flange local buckling
notes: The web is not classified in the example (h/tw not listed).

F.5.title: W12x58, minor axis: yielding
notes: Compact flanges asserted by the example (User Note of Spec. F6).
Rounded chain: Fy Zy = 1,625 kip-in. = 135.4 kip-ft is printed as 136 kip-ft before the factors are applied.

F.7B.title: HSS10x6x3/16, major axis, braced at the ends: noncompact flange, LTB capped at Mp
notes: Ix = 74.6 in.^4, the span and the load are listed in Example F.7A (F-32 to F-33, PDF 194-195).
The example cites the LTB equations as Spec. Eq. F7-10, F7-12 and F7-13; in ANSI/AISC 360-22 as supplied the same equations are numbered F7-8, F7-10 and F7-11.

F.8B.title: HSS8x8x3/16, slender flange: effective width and effective section modulus
notes: The example removes the ineffective width from both flanges (no neutral-axis shift), which is the method of the engine.

F.9B.title: Pipe 8 x-Strong: yielding
notes: S is not listed (not needed: compact).

H.1B.title: W14x99, compression and biaxial flexure: Eq. H1-1a with tabulated available strengths
notes: The available strengths are Manual Table 6-1 values (no section property is listed): only the interaction equation is reproduced.

H.3.title: W14x82, tension and biaxial flexure: D2-1, F2-2, F6-1, H1-1b
notes: Lp and Lr are Manual Table 3-2 values (rts, J, ho are not listed), so Eq. F2-2 is evaluated with them as inputs.

Cb = 1.41 = 1.24 x 1.14: the example applies the optional increase of Spec. H1.2 (Eq. H1-2), with the LRFD factor 1.24 for both methods. The engine does not apply that increase; Cb = 1.41 is an input of the test.

H.4.title: W10x33, compression and biaxial flexure with B1: A-8-3, A-8-5, F2-2, F6-1, H1-1b
notes: Pc is a Manual Table 6-1 value (the area is not listed) and Lp, Lr are Manual Table 3-2 values: they are inputs of the test.
The first-order moments (Mx1, My1) are amplified by B1 with Cm = 1.0 and the unreduced EI; the example multiplies with the rounded B1 (1.02, 1.09).
